idiom.title: Like there is no tomorrow
idiom.glossZh: “像没有明天一样” 或 “不顾明天”。
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from a sense of urgency and living in the moment, implying that today might be the last day, so one should do something to the fullest. It is typically used to describe people doing something in large quantities, without regard for the future consequences, such as spending, eating, or working.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语起源于一种紧迫感和尽情享受当下的精神，暗指今天可能是最后一天，所以要尽情去做某事。这个表达通常用来形容人们不顾后果地大量做某事，比如消费、吃喝或者工作。

examples.en: They were spending money like there is no tomorrow during their vacation.
examples.zh: 他们在度假时花钱像没有明天一样。

examples.en: She ate those chocolates like there is no tomorrow.
examples.zh: 她像没有明天一样吃那些巧克力。

examples.en: He’s working like there is no tomorrow to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 为了按时完成项目，他正在拼命工作，像没有明天一样。

people.name: Steven Miles
people.extract: Steven John Miles is an Australian politician who served as the 40th premier of Queensland from 2023 to 2024. He has been the leader of the Queensland Labor Party since 2023 and the leader of the opposition in Queensland since 2024, and previously served as deputy premier from 2020 to 2023.
highlights: Leader of Queensland Labor Party since 2023.
Leader of opposition in Queensland since 2024.
